title: Da Nang’s 2026 fireworks nights are over
summary: DIFF and Vietnam Tourism both list six 2026 nights on the Han River, from 30 May through 11 July. Those nights have passed. Neither page prints a 2027 calendar. Next year’s dates are check on arrival.
when: The 2026 nights have passed. Next year’s dates are check on arrival.
photoAlt: The Han River and Da Nang’s bridge
body: Do not plan a June trip around last summer’s poster. The festival site lists the 2026 competition nights on the Han River as 30 May, 6 June, 13 June, 20 June, 27 June, and the finale on 11 July, under the theme United Horizons. Vietnam Tourism prints the same span and the same six nights.
October is well after that finale. The pages checked for this note do not publish a 2027 list. Until they do, next year’s dates are check on arrival.

sources.label: DIFF, the Da Nang fireworks festival
Vietnam National Administration of Tourism, DIFF 2026
